name: DualSense (PS5, Bluetooth, Full Descriptor)
notes: Current Sony firmware. productString reports 'DualSense Wireless Controller' (launch firmware reported 'Wireless Controller' — see dualsense-bt for that variant). Adds feature reports F4-F7 missing from the launch capture, including 0xF6 (546-byte IMU calibration response). Descriptor extracted by HIDMaestroProfileExtractor on 2026-04-29 from a newly-purchased DualSense; HIDAPI-reconstructed verbose form (logically equivalent to firmware-emitted descriptor but not byte-identical). Validated end-to-end via PadForge custom-profile path on the same controller. Report 0x01 input layout matches dualsense-bt (4 axes, hat, 14 buttons, 6-bit pad, 2-byte triggers); buttonMap/triggerButtons/axisMap carried over unchanged.
